name: Shinjitsu no Koi wa Bed no Naka de ~Jouzu na Aisarekata~
original_name: 真実の恋はベッドの中で～上手な愛され方～
source:
As a love counselor, the protagonist is great at figuring people out, but as soon as it's about her, she gets shy and timid.
Still, she gets into a relationship with him...?!
Your choices can change her destiny!

[Translated from [url=http://www.andamul.com/special/kankei.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
作为爱情顾问，主角很擅长看透他人，但一旦事情涉及自己，她就会变得害羞而胆怯。
即便如此，她还是与他发展成了恋人……？！
你的选择能够改变她的命运！

[翻译自[url=http://www.andamul.com/special/kankei.html]官网[/url]]
